title: Surjective fixed raw scalar comparison
statement: For every commutative ring Λ, k:W→S, module sheaf G on W, q∈ℕ, U∈S.Etale and A∈Over(W), the underlying additive map of rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A [def-sbc-raw-module-abelian-hom-map] is surjective.

proof.text:
Fix an abelian derived class. Resolve A.hom^*G by injective module
sheaves. By Tag 03FD the underlying abelian terms are acyclic for evaluation on
every etale object, including V = U times_S A.left. Therefore the section complex
of this forgotten resolution computes the target derived Hom from the pulled-back
free represented abelian sheaf. Represent the given class by a section cocycle in
that complex. The very same cocycle in the module section complex defines a module
derived class, using the free represented module sections adjunction. The explicit
map forgets this cocycle without changing it: freeMap carries the identity generator
to the identity generator, while the single, shift and inverse-image comparisons
identify the same section. Consequently the image of the module class is the given
abelian class. No lifting of arbitrary abelian sheaf morphisms to module morphisms
is asserted; only sections of this module resolution are used. Degree zero, the
zero ring and empty V are included by the identical section-complex calculation.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03FD; W3 separates the class detection and class lifting parts of the existing comparison argument

mathlib_searches.query: Injectivity and surjectivity of the derived section comparison from module sheaves to abelian sheaves
Forgetting scalars induces bijection on derived Hom from a free represented module sheaf to a shifted sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: Free represented sections equivalences only; no explicit raw scalar map comparison
extAddEquivCohomologyClass exists for injective resolutions, but no scalar comparison
Mathlib bijectivity requires a fully faithful functor preserving injectives; no match for scalar forgetting. No duplicate raw-map clauses in the library/DAG.

from.place: Explicit raw scalar comparison: surjective part of componentwise invertibility

theorem rawModuleAbelianHomMap_surjective
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ)
    (U : S.Etale) (A : Over W) :
    Function.Surjective (rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A).hom
